title: CLI list-valued options must not absorb the following option token
description: Fix an input-layer defect that lets a list-valued option swallow the following option token. With Commander 15, `.option("--depends-on <id...>")` given no values of its own captures the next option name and its values as its own: `task create x --title T --depends-on --description desc --json` parses to dependencies ["--description","desc"]. When the captured token fails the record-id rule the whole create is rejected with a misleading "must be filesystem-safe" message, and when it passes the free-text rule the wrong value is written silently with exit status 0: `task create q --title Q --acceptance --json` created a record whose acceptance list is ["--json"], and `task update p4 --path-hint --json` replaced that record's path hints with ["--json"]. Guard the CLI input layer so a list-valued flag can never consume an option-looking token, report a value-less flag as such, keep space-separated multi-value usage working, and give update commands an explicit spelling for clearing a list.
acceptance: Every list-valued flag on every mutating command (task create/update, issue create/update, message, handoff) refuses an option-looking token with a coded diagnostic naming the flag, a nonzero exit status and no record written; the four observed shapes become regression tests.
The silent variant is asserted at record level: after a refused call the record's acceptance, path hints, dependencies and prompts are byte-identical to before.

Legitimate usage still works: space-separated multi-value (--depends-on a b c) and a repeated flag both accumulate, and each update command has a documented explicit way to clear a list, shown in --help.
A list option given no values reports that it requires at least one value, never a schema message about filesystem safety.
The guard is one shared CLI helper with no core schema change, and bun test, typecheck and validate --project --views all pass.
notes: Found while creating the W00-W10 records (docs/waystation-git-hermes-implementation-plan.md section 18.1), with probe evidence against a throwaway ledger created through `init --root`. --depends-on and --prompt fail loudly through the record-id rule change, while --path-hint and --acceptance fail silently because those fields accept any non-empty string. `sync --views` taking no --actor is correct behavior, since it appends no events, and is not part of this fix. No W00-W10 record depends on this one.
